name: modulardt_backend
description: 1. Python 3.14.4 required 2. Create a virtual environment `python -m venv .venv` 3. Activate the virtual environment: Linux/macOS `source .venv/bin/activate` on Windows  `.venv\Scripts\activate` or Windows PowerShell `.venv\Scripts\Activate` 4. Install required packages: `pip install -r requirements.txt` 5. Create the database and migrate it by running `python manage.py migrate` - should create db.sqlite3 file
